BiblicalUsage: Tenth is the ordinal, the tenth part and the tenth hour and the tenth foundation of the city. The tenth hour is when Andrew and John first abode with Jesus, the tenth part of the city falls in the earthquake, and the tenth foundation of the wall is the chrysoprasus. The tenth is the measure of the whole.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tenth hour is the hour worth remembering: the day Andrew first sat with Jesus is the day his life changed. The tenth hour is the hour the disciple remembers, and the remembering is the beginning of the following.
